question: At C-0086's buildable 38.08 nm, is the count/phase interaction the same object C-0108 measured at 40.00 nm, and does the recommended (count, phase) endpoint move?

conditions.tile: single-layer square-lattice sheet, 15 duplexes at the SAXS 2.69 nm (40.35 nm across the helices, UNCHANGED at both widths); along-helix width 38.08 nm (112 bp, C-0086's buildable seamless raster row) against 40.00 nm (S3's nominal, C-0108's)
conditions.endOfRow: row-end column ADMITTED is primary (C-0095 on the permission, C-0099 on the mechanics); REFUSED is carried as the declared bracket
conditions.load: C-0022's SOLVED edge profile at 2 mM, a 10 nm gap and 0.192 V, its collar terms carried unchanged to the narrower tile as C-0090 carries them
conditions.mandate: C-0017's 33.3333333 pN/nm as a SUM at S3's acceptable 3 nm, shared EQUALLY at every count and every phase
conditions.dropout: C-0087's MEASURED_DEPTH incorporation field evaluated on THIS width's own tile, one Bernoulli stream per phase, restricted per subset
conditions.statistic: the 90th percentile, nearest rank, over that width's own free stroke
conditions.flatness: T-5b's 0.10 CONVENTION, not a physical threshold
conditions.family: C-0108's CANONICAL search-free nested chain, unchanged

decision: THE WIDTH DOES NOT MOVE THE INTERACTION, AND THE GUARD'S VALUE DOES NOTHING AT ALL. At the buildable 38.08 nm the EDGE_MARGIN sweep 0.05 / 0.17 / 0.34 nm leaves ONE lattice under the truncation C-0108 was run on, so the axis the brief expected to dominate is settled by arithmetic; what is not inert is the guard's EXISTENCE, the binary C-0095 and C-0099 already closed. On the 2 x 2 the recommendation moves through - whose station sets are bit-identical at the two widths - the interaction is -6.707071 per cent at 38.08 nm against -5.742024 per cent at 40.00 nm, and the total 3.909456 against 6.488877 per cent. Over the 32 x 6 grid the two axes are NOT separable at either width: the worst additive residual is 7.812259 per cent of a level at 38.08 nm against 7.725089 per cent at 40.00 nm, carrying 8.604800 per cent of the variation against 9.792182 per cent. The argmin moves from phase 6 at 45 paths to phase 8 at 45 paths. The 34 -> 30 count term is adverse at 25 of 32 admitted phases and at 23 of 32 refused ones. Nothing here is flat: 192 of 192 graded admitted cells exceed T-5b's 0.10 at the 90th percentile.

cheapBounds.name: bound 1 - the EDGE_MARGIN sweep as a LATTICE statement, no solve at all
cheapBounds.settles: THE AXIS THE BRIEF EXPECTED TO DOMINATE. At the buildable width the guard's VALUE is exactly inert over 0.05 nm, half a rise and one rise - one lattice, worst station displacement 0.000000000 nm - because a column that lands ON the edge is deleted by any positive inset and the next one in is a whole 16 bp pitch further. At the NOMINAL width the same sweep leaves 2 lattices, the column count moving at phases 6, 10, 22, 26. What is not inert at 38.08 nm is the guard's EXISTENCE, which is a binary

cheapBounds.name: bound 2 - C-0102's congruence, and the collapse of the strata
cheapBounds.unit: phases at which the end plane is a COLUMN
cheapBounds.settles: which phases are structurally comparable at the buildable width. The end plane exists at 0, 8, 16 and 24 and is a column only at 8 and 24; admitting it those two carry eight columns and every other phase seven, and refusing it those two carry SIX and no phase carries eight. So C-0015's ten eight-column phases become two or none, and a cell-by-cell comparison against the 40.00 nm grid is not a comparison of the same strata

cheapBounds.name: bound 3 - the 2 x 2's own corners carry IDENTICAL stations at the two widths
cheapBounds.settles: what the headline comparison holds fixed. At phases 8 and 24 the buildable admitted station lattice is bit-identical to the 40.00 nm one (C-0090, re-derived here as a test), and the COLUMNS are not - so every difference between the two widths' 2 x 2 is host geometry and load, and none of it is which stations were available

cheapBounds.name: bound 4 - the path identity: four graded cells decide the headline
cheapBounds.settles: how expensive the answer is. The two orderings of the 2 x 2 share their endpoints, so the interaction is one number from four cells; the 32 x 6 grid buys the generality and not the verdict. Measured: -6.707071 per cent at 38.08 nm against -5.742024 per cent at 40.00 nm

cheapBounds.name: bound 5 - the free tile is a function of the phase at this width too
cheapBounds.settles: the baseline every coupling is judged against. Over the admitted hosts the uncoupled tile dishes 0.299035 to 0.305394 of the stroke, so a p90 quoted without its host is not quoted at a state

findings: THE GUARD'S VALUE IS INERT AT THE BUILDABLE WIDTH AND NOT AT THE NOMINAL ONE, WHICH IS THE OPPOSITE WAY ROUND FROM THE EXPECTATION. Swept over 0.05 nm, half a rise and one rise, CrossoverLayout.EDGE_MARGIN leaves 1 distinct lattice(s) over the 32 phases of the buildable 38.08 nm tile under the truncation C-0108 was run on - worst station displacement 0.000000000 nm, worst column-count change 0 - and 2 at 40.00 nm, where the column count moves at phases 6, 10, 22, 26. The reason is a lattice one and needs no solve: at a width that is an exact whole number of column pitches the row-end column sits ON the edge, so ANY positive inset deletes it and the next column in is a whole 16 bp = 5.44 nm further; at 40.00 nm the closest approach is 0.28 nm, which one rise crosses. So the guard at this width is not a tolerance at all - it is a BINARY, and it is the one C-0095 and C-0099 already closed.

AND ADMITTING THE ROW END MAKES THE GUARD A POSITION RATHER THAN A TRUNCATION, WORTH 0.444235 PER CENT OF A LEVEL. With the row-end plane kept, the inset decides WHERE it sits, so the same sweep leaves 3 lattices - the stations moving at phases 0, 16 by exactly one rise less the guard, 0.290000000 nm, and the column count moving nowhere. Graded at 16 cells the whole spread is 0.004442352 of a level, against C-0090's 0.32 per cent on its own searched placement.

THE STRATA ARE NOT THE SAME SETS, AND THE CENSUS SAYS SO BEFORE ANY SOLVE. At 38.08 nm with the row end admitted 2 of 32 phases carry the richest column count (8) - they are 8, 24 - and 2 carry the richest inventory (60 sites), which are 0, 16; refusing the row end takes those same two phases to 6 columns and no phase carries more than 7. C-0015's ten eight-column phases at 40.00 nm have therefore become two or none, and the 32 x 6 grids at the two widths are different objects compared as summary statistics and never cell by cell.

THE COUNT TERM AT EVERY PHASE OF THE BUILDABLE TILE. The 34 -> 30 reduction on the canonical search-free family is adverse at 25 of 32 admitted phases and favourable at 7, running -3.964855 to 12.075078 per cent, against C-0108's -4.59519576 to +12.2058991 per cent at 40.00 nm. Under the refused convention it is adverse at 23 of 32 and runs -13.761107 to 10.920098 per cent.

THE TWO AXES ARE NOT SEPARABLE AT EITHER WIDTH, AND THE INTERACTION IS THE SAME SIZE. The balanced two-way additive fit in log p90 leaves a worst residual of 0.075221185 log units at 38.08 nm admitted (7.812259 per cent of a level, 1.870858 of its own 34 -> 30 count main effect) against 0.074412322 log units at 40.00 nm (7.725089 per cent, 1.532347 of its count main effect); the variation splits 5.649448 per cent phase, 85.745752 per cent count and 8.604800 per cent interaction at 38.08 nm against 7.836103, 82.371715 and 9.792182 at 40.00 nm. Both decompositions close to 0.000000000 and 0.000000000, which is the orthogonality of a balanced design and is asserted as a gate. Under the refused convention the same fit leaves 0.180411910 log units and 11.318476 per cent of the variation.

THE HEADLINE 2 x 2, MATCHED ON STATIONS AND NOT ON HOSTS. At phases 24 and 8 the buildable admitted station lattice is bit-identical to the 40.00 nm one, so the 2 x 2 differs only in the host and the load. Count first then phase reads 12.075078 then -7.285850 per cent at 38.08 nm against 10.839768 then -3.925387 at 40.00 nm; phase first then count reads -0.620389 then 4.558123 against 1.927303 then 4.475321. The total is 3.909456 per cent against 6.488877 (path disagreement 0.000000000 and 0.000000000), and the interaction -6.707071 per cent against -5.742024. Refusing the row-end column the same 2 x 2 reads a total of 13.928410 per cent and an interaction of -20.284302 per cent, so the CONVENTION moves the split further than the WIDTH does.

AND THE RECOMMENDED ENDPOINT. Over the whole 32 x 6 grid the argmin is phase 8 at 45 paths (0.641991 of the stroke) at the buildable width against phase 6 at 45 paths (0.682356) at the nominal one; held at 34 paths the best phase is 8 against 22, and held at 30 paths 8 against 8. Refusing the row-end column the argmin is phase 9 at 45 paths (0.675633). Neither is flat: T-5b's convention is 0.10.

UNDER THE MEASURED DROPOUT THE WHOLE FAMILY IS A NET DISHING SOURCE AT THE BUILDABLE WIDTH TOO. 192 of 192 admitted cells and 192 of 192 refused ones exceed their own host's uncoupled dishing at the 90th percentile, and 192 of 192 and 192 of 192 exceed T-5b's 0.10; the worst admitted cell is 1.001820 of the stroke. So neither the width, nor the count, nor the phase, nor the end-of-row convention decides an acceptance verdict on this branch - exactly as C-0103 found at one phase and C-0108 at thirty-two.

THE VERDICT ON C-0108 AT THE BUILDABLE WIDTH. F1 FIRED, F2 did not fire and F3 did not fire. C-0108's finding transfers to the width the design can build: the interaction is the same sign and within a factor of two, the two axes are not separable at either width, and the recommendation still rests on the TOTAL, which is path-independent.
validity: TRL 1-3. Model-consistent and traceable. The dropout INPUT is C-0087's, which is Strauss et al. (2018) read directly on a plain Rothemund rectangle; nothing derived here is measured.
The motif is NOT demonstrated: a free lever held to a single-layer sheet by one crossover is this programme's own construct (C-0028, C-0029, C-0055).

The 32 x 6 grids at the two widths are DIFFERENT OBJECTS - the site inventories and the column censuses differ - so they are compared as summary statistics of one construction on two lattices, never cell by cell. Only the 2 x 2 at phases 24 and 8 is matched, and it is matched on STATIONS and not on hosts.
The strata are recomputed at this width and are not C-0102's sets: at 38.08 nm with the row end admitted the richest-column phases are {8, 24} alone and the richest inventory belongs to {0, 16}.

C-0022's collar terms are carried unchanged to the narrower tile rather than re-solved, exactly as C-0090 carries them; C-0026's edge enhancement is a function of the tile size and this is the inherited approximation.
EQUAL springs at every cell. The distribution axis is C-0089's and T-179's; nothing here bounds the three-way interaction of count, phase and distribution.

ONE anchor rule and ONE load state, as C-0108: the canonical chain is a third rule beside C-0103's two, and the levels carry that rule dependence. The signs, the interaction and the argmin are what is read.
T-5b's 0.10 is a CONVENTION, not a physical threshold.
